# rebutted

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:justificationStatusRebutted`](gmeow-justificationStatusRebutted.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/justificationStatusRebutted>

A rebutting justification-defeat marker — positive reason has been given to believe the negation of the target doxastic state or standpoint-claim, attacking the conclusion directly. Aligns with [`gmeow:defeaterRebutting`](gmeow-defeaterRebutting.md) in the inference slice. A solver-set flag only; never reasoner-promoted.
